understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid, configure the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation match each goal cell, then step onto every activated goal to complete all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs stamina, and reaching zero costs a life before restoring stamina. Walls block movement and blocked_directions must be checked before acting. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activates when all three attributes match, but it is only completed by stepping onto it. Careful route planning is necessary because wasted or blocked moves consume stamina.
